title: Discover
objectives: Understand the business landscape, audience needs, and technical constraints. Uncover the hidden opportunities.

title: Strategy
objectives: Define the conceptual and structural foundation. Align business goals with user experience pathways.

title: Design
objectives: Craft the visual language and interaction paradigms. Transform structural plans into compelling, sophisticated aesthetics.

title: Build
objectives: Transform designs into semantic, performant, and secure code. Integrate dynamic CMS workflows.

title: Launch
objectives: Deploy the project to production securely and verify all integrations and performance guidelines.

title: Optimize
objectives: Monitor user interactions, audit speed performance metrics, and iterate based on real-world data.
